Build plan with hard rules and planner decisions B1-B10: docs/plan/phase2-build-plan.md. Closes every TRACEABILITY row with status 'rework' assigned to FEAT-005. Depends on Phase 1 (approved). Plan: docs/PLAN.md (Phase 1 rework). Requirement rows: docs/TRACEABILITY.md.
steps: Item 22: Hard ceiling and size measurement (DESIGN §12.6, §9.14; rows DES-FR-21, DES-AC-39, CR4-2d, CR4-2g, CR4-2h, CR4-2o, CR3-U13, CHAT-31, CHAT-32). `common/config.py`: `DiffPolicy` defaults `max_files: 80`, `max_changed_lines: 3000`, new `max_test_lines: 3000`; new strict `SizePolicy` (`autonomous_max_class`, `preferred_classes`, `overrun_tolerance`, `on_overrun`, `exclude_globs`, `test_globs`; a validator rejects an `autonomous_max_class` whose bounds exceed the ceiling), `DiscoveryFilters` and `ProposalPolicy` with the §9.14 defaults; `config/policy.yaml` updated (comments kept). Remove `max_changed_lines` from `TargetDefaults`/`RepoEntry` (replaced by an optional per-repo `size_class` preference, autonomous only) and from `ResolvedTarget`; `policy.check_diff` splits gatekeeper numstat into code and test lines (`test_globs`), drops `exclude_globs`, and reports `too_many_files`, `too_many_code_lines`, `too_many_test_lines` against the ceiling only. A test enumerates every token purpose, command and API route and asserts none can write `policy.diff`. Files: `src/ossbot/common/config.py`, `config/policy.yaml`, `config/targets.yaml`, `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/policy.py`, `tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_policy.py`, `tests/unit/common/test_config.py`, `tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_ceiling_not_writable.py` Verify: `DEV pytest -m unit tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_policy.py tests/unit/common/test_config.py tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_ceiling_not_writable.py` green (80/3000/3000 edges, test lines never count as code, lockfiles/vendored excluded, a target value can no longer lower the ceiling).

Item 23: Research egress and egress modes (DESIGN §11.3, §11.5, §10.3; rows DES-FR-18, DES-AC-33, DES-AC-34, ADR-0005, CR2-1a, CR2-1b, CR2-1d, CR2-1e, CR2-2a, CR2-2b, CR2-2c, CR2-6b, CR2-6c, CHAT-23, CHAT-24, P1-15, P1-18). `config/egress.yaml`: category `github_user_content` (`.github.io`, `gist.github.com`, `gist.githubusercontent.com`) for `research` and host caller `hermes`; `always_denied` keeps `uploads.github.com`, `checkpoint-api.hashicorp.com`, adds `telegra.ph`, `api.telegra.ph`, `edit.telegra.ph` and `::/128` (P1-15), with a why-comment per entry; `mode_default: open`; per-mode grants (`modes: {allowlist, research, open}`) as data. `ctl/render.py` renders squid for (snapshot, mode) with assertions that fail the render if any invariant of §11.5 differs between modes (fetch/validate never `web_public`; gatekeeper/runner identical; denied_dst, IP literals, DNS identical) and that `agent-llm`/`catalog` get the same list. Control flag `egress-mode` (fail closed `allowlist`), `POST /v1/control/egress-mode` (human/operator only, audited, FYI), `ossctl egress mode <m>` (TTY confirm), root `systemd/ossbot-egress.path` + `ossbot-egress-apply.service` + `scripts/bin/ossbot-egress-apply` (re-render, reconfigure the proxy), `ossbot-firewall --check` and the watchdog compare the running squid config with the render for the current mode; doctor and `/status` show the mode. Goldens per mode; `tests/sandbox/test_profiles.py` gains the github.io/gist case (200 for research, 403 for fetch/validate/agent-llm outside `open`; uses a local fixture host when offline); `tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh` updated (hermes 3141 reaches `x.github.io.`/`gist.github.com.`; code-running profiles 403). VERIFICATION.md threat-table rows 7/36 reworded (P1-18). The Telegram `/egress` command is FEAT-009. Files: `config/egress.yaml`, `src/ossbot/common/config.py`, `src/ossbot/ctl/render.py`, `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/{control.py,api/control.py}`, `src/ossbot/common/control_flags.py`, `scripts/bin/{ossbot-egress-apply,ossbot-firewall}`, `systemd/ossbot-egress.{path,service}`, `scripts/lib/services.sh`, `tests/unit/ctl/{test_render.py,golden/squid.*.conf}`, `tests/sandbox/test_profiles.py`, `tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh`, `docs/VERIFICATION.md` Verify: `DEV pytest -m unit tests/unit/ctl` green for all three modes; after redeploy `ROOTDEV pytest -m sandbox` and `ROOT bash tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh` green; `ROOT /opt/ossbot/bin/ossbot-firewall --check` exits 0 in `open` and after `ossctl egress mode allowlist`. Carried detail from the interrupted planner draft (FEAT numbers remapped; DESIGN revision 5 and the item text above win on any conflict, e.g. no Pillow in the gatekeeper, streaming via drafts, decision services from FEAT-005): Draft item 16: egress data and modes (CR-002 req 1, 2, 6). config/egress.yaml: move .github.io, gist.github.com, gist.githubusercontent.com from always_denied.domains to a new category github_user_content granted to the research profile and host caller hermes (3141); uploads.github.com stays always-denied; add a 'why' comment per remaining always-denied name. Add modes: allowlist (named categories only, no web_public anywhere), research (today + github_user_content), open (research + web_public for agent-llm AND catalog, because they share the llm pool and the renderer refuses pool-mates with different categories - VERIFICATION.md CR-002 note); fetch and validate never get web_public in any mode; gatekeeper/runner host_callers identical in every mode (a renderer assertion, not data). Mode state: config default egress.yaml 'mode_default: open' via the snapshot, the active mode in /var/lib/ossbot/control/egress-mode (JSON {mode, actor, ts}; gatekeeper:osscontrol; unparseable -> allowlist, fail closed). Changing it here: 'ossctl egress mode <mode>' (TTY confirm; the Telegram /egress picker is item 47) -> gatekeeper writes the flag, audits, FYIs -> root systemd/ossbot-egress.path + ossbot-egress-apply.service -> scripts/bin/ossbot-egress-apply re-renders squid via ossbot.ctl.render for the snapshot + mode and reconfigures the proxy container; 'ossbot-firewall --check' / watchdog compare the running squid conf with the render for the current mode. Update the squid golden(s) per mode (tests/unit/ctl/golden/squid.<mode>.conf), tests/unit/ctl/test_render.py (every mode: invariants identical; fetch/validate never web_public; agent-llm web_public only in open), and tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh (hermes raw CONNECT to x.github.io./gist.github.com. now 200-class through 3141 in research/open; code-running profiles still 403) plus a new tests/sandbox case: research profile 200 on a known *.github.io page and a public gist (raw too), fetch/validate/agent-llm(non-open) 403. DESIGN §11.3/§11.5 and the ADR-0005 revision-5 amendment already describe this; record implementation findings in an ADR-0005 addendum.

Item 23a (docs/plan/phase2-build-plan.md, planner decision B2): Hermes capability-tier control plane, no Hermes needed (FEAT-005 part of rows CR2-3a, CR2-3b, CR2-3e, CR2-6a, ADR-0018; their status stays missing until item 36, the evidence column records this part, and the phase column becomes 'P1-rework FEAT-005 (control plane) + P2 FEAT-007 ...'). `PolicyConfig.hermes: HermesPolicy(capability_tier_default: Literal['locked','research','self_improve'] = 'self_improve')` and `config/policy.yaml` `hermes.capability_tier_default: self_improve`; `common/control_flags.py` `read_hermes_tier(control_dir, default)` (missing -> default; unparseable, oversize or unknown -> `locked`); new `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/chat/__init__.py` and `chat/hermes_surface.py` with `TIER_TOOLSETS` (locked: memory, todo, session_search, ossbot; research: + web only once item 33 confirms Hermes-native web tools go through HTTPS_PROXY 3141, until then equal to locked via a module constant; self_improve: + skills), `ALWAYS_DISABLED` (terminal, code_execution, file, browser, delegation, cronjob) and `allowed_toolsets(tier)`; `ControlService.set_hermes_tier(tier, actor)` writes /var/lib/ossbot/control/hermes-tier with `write_flag`, audits `hermes_tier_changed`, FYIs and, in the same transaction, calls `ctx.decisions.skills.invalidate_all_open('tier_changed')` (implement after item 24); `POST /v1/control/hermes-tier` (operator role), `ossctl hermes tier [<tier>]` (TTY confirm when setting); doctor shows the tier; import-linter: `ossbot.gatekeeper.chat` never imports `submit`/`github_writer`. Tests: new tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_hermes_surface.py, tests/unit/common/test_control_flags.py (tier fail-closed), tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_control.py (audit, FYI, tier_changed invalidation). Verify: `DEV pytest -m unit` green; lint gate clean.

Item 24: Token and approval core deltas 1–9 and the decision services (DESIGN §14.18.4, §14.18.2; rows TGRW-1, TGRW-2, TGRW-3, TGRW-4, TGRW-6, TGRW-7, CR3-S1, CR3-AC-29, CR3-AC-31, CR3-AC-46, CR3-AC-47, CR3-AC-57, CR3-AC-58, CR3-BA-1, CR3-BA-3, CR3-BA-4, CR3-BA-5, CR3-BA-17, CR3-M1, CR4-1f, ADR-0003, ADR-0004, ADR-0008). `approvals.py`: `DECISION_PURPOSES`, `card_purposes(kind, has_interdiff)` with multi-use view tokens (delta 3), `disarm_expired()` (delta 2), `create(…, expires_at=)`, `reissue(cid, *, tg_chat_id, actor, part_count, keep_expiry=False)` + `reissue_eligible()` and the confirmed-sibling refusal (deltas 5, 7), `Invalidated` with optional `action_id`/`cid`. New `decisions.py` (`DecisionService` protocol, `DecisionServices.for_id/all`), `proposal_approvals.py` and `skill_approvals.py` (ids `p_…`/`s_…` via `common/ids.py`, two-tap, single-use, message-bound, binding hashes recomputed before the effect; content fields filled by FEAT-006/007) over migration `0002_decisions.sql` (tables `proposal_approvals`, `skill_approvals`, `tg_views`, `tg_thread_seq` and the `tg_outbox` columns `result_message_id`, `bind_tokens_json`, `view_json`; the migration split is DESIGN §14.20.2). `context.py`: `reissue`, `reissue_proposal`, `reissue_skill`, `card_recover`. `app.housekeeping_once`: `expire_due` + `disarm_expired` on every service, then `card_recover`. Kill (four sites in `control.py`) and reload (`config_snapshot.py`) fan out over `ctx.decisions.all()` (delta 9). `outbox.mark_sent(row, result)` binds tokens and writes `tg_views` in one transaction (delta 6); `CardPublisher` dispatches through `ctx.decisions.for_id` and has `recover()` (delta 8). `state_machine.sweep_expired` uses the newest approval's window start and cancels pending actions. Files: `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/{approvals.py,decisions.py,proposal_approvals.py,skill_approvals.py,context.py,app.py,control.py,config_snapshot.py,outbox.py,state_machine.py}`, `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/telegram/bot.py`, `src/ossbot/common/ids.py`, `src/ossbot/gatekeeper/migrations/0002_decisions.sql`, `tests/unit/gatekeeper/{test_approvals.py,test_reissue_part_counts.py,test_reissue_eligibility.py,test_decision_fanout.py,test_card_recover.py,test_dedupe_keys.py,test_outbox.py}` Verify: `DEV pytest -m "unit or telegram"` green, including the BA-1 AST test, kill and reload invalidating all three services, expiry kept on re-send (AC 46), crash between `mark_sent` and `on_sent` healed (AC 31); every existing Phase 1 approval test still passes.

Item 26: Round-6 NITs and the no-exposure guard (rows DES-FR-22, DES-AC-42, CHAT-33, CR3-CF-1, CR3-S4, P1-16, P1-17, P1-19, ADR-0013). No exposure: `tests/system/test_no_exposure.sh` (no non-loopback TCP/UDP listener in the distro except documented container bridges with no published ports; `ss -ltnup` parsed) and `tests/unit/test_no_tunnels.py` (no `cloudflared`, `ngrok`, `tailscale funnel`/`serve`, webhook URL or tunnel config in the repo, Dockerfiles, compose, provisioning or units).
